definitions.explanation: A performance of rhythmic movement, often traditional Japanese dance.

examples.japanese: ⟦{盆|ぼん}{踊|おど}り→盆踊り：05638_bonodori⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{参加|さんか}→参加：02498_sanka⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I participated in the Bon dance.

examples.japanese: {踊|おど}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{習|なら}っています→習う：00479_narau⟧。
⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦{舞踊|ぶよう}→舞踊：05410_buyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{踊|おど}り

notes:
{踊|おど}り is a noun meaning 'dance,' derived from the verb ⟦{踊|おど}る→踊る：01250_odoru⟧.

Types of dance in Japanese:
- {踊|おど}り: general dance, often traditional
- ⟦ダンス→ダンス：03856_dansu⟧: Western-style dance
- ⟦{舞踊|ぶよう}→舞踊：05410_buyou⟧: formal/artistic dance
- ⟦{舞|まい}→舞：noentry⟧: classical/elegant dance (more literary)

Common compounds:
- ⟦{盆|ぼん}{踊|おど}り→盆踊り：05638_bonodori⟧: Bon dance (summer festival dance)
- ⟦{民謡|みんよう}→民謡：07083_minyou⟧{踊|おど}り: folk dance
- {踊|おど}り⟦{子|こ}→子：09851_ko⟧: dancer (traditional)
